name: Maru Mini 3x3 Keychain Cube
description: The Maru Mini 3x3 Keychain cube measures just 3cm across, making it almost twice as small as most conventional 3x3 cubes. It is extremely lightweight, and this version features a keychain. For such a small cube, it features a robust internal mechanism and turns smoothly. The "Dice" color features fancy dice patterns across the cube in place of the colors.
